idea-plugin.name: Focus Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Six high-separation dark themes designed for fast scanning. Each gives every kind of type a colour of its own - class, interface, record, struct and enum are five different hues, not five shades of one - so the shape of a file reads before you read a word of it.

The same six palettes ship for Visual Studio, VS Code and Cursor. They are generated from one table, so a theme is the same theme in every editor.

Every syntax hue clears WCAG AA against its own background. Comments, the gutter and regex pattern text are held to 3:1 instead - deliberately, so commentary recedes rather than competing with code.
